attempts.text:
<plan>
drive car1 naukunda-shelter likhu-school
load car1 adult 3
drive car1 likhu-school naukunda-shelter
unload car1 adult 3
defer benighat-farm adult 3
</plan>
COST: 102

Naukunda shelter is the only confirmed evacuation point, so all rescued people must end there. The Benighat farm adults are deferred. Reaching them takes at least 86 driving minutes (there and back via Likhu school, since the direct road is blocked), which costs more than the 60-minute penalty for deferring three adults. The three Likhu school adults are rescued in one 42-minute round trip, which fits the car's capacity of four.
